title: Horse Breaking Barriers
description: A dapple grey horse rears powerfully in the center of the composition, its mane and tail flying wildly as it bursts through a chaotic arrangement of large orange blocks and shattered red wooden beams. The horse appears to be breaking free from the collapsing structure, with fragments and debris scattered around its hooves.
prompt: A powerful dapple grey horse rearing up on its hind legs, breaking through a collapsing wall of large orange rectangular blocks and shattered red wooden beams. The horse has a wild flowing mane, dramatic lighting from above with strong orange highlights, dark purple background, intense and dynamic composition showing the moment of breakthrough with flying debris and broken structures.
